fields.summary_ko.0: KB Securities analyzes Samsung Electronics' current position—down more than 50% from peak—as a 'turning point for rebound,' noting that over the past 20 years, 97% of gains followed declines of 40% or more within 60 days.
fields.summary_ko.1: Operating profits for 2025 and 2026 are expected to reach KRW 381 trillion and KRW 640 trillion respectively, representing 774% and 68% increases year-over-year, though the current 3x PER indicates a historic maximum gap between stock price and earnings.
